_comment: Trigger set for the design-md skill description. Each entry states what the
query is probing, so a failure says which claim in the description broke rather
than only that a number moved.
'Use when authoring, auditing, or exporting a DESIGN.md design system — design
tokens, tailwind config, deslopify a generic look, дизайн-система, фирменные
цвета, единый стиль, извлеки палитру по скриншоту, or derive one from a brief
Negatives are chosen to sit NEAR the boundary, not far from it. A description
that fires on everything design-shaped is as broken as one that never fires; a
distant negative ('convert this PNG to JPEG') proves nothing either way.
A query must SUPPLY whatever it refers to. Both original misses in this set were
artifacts of asking about a screenshot and a brief that were never provided: the
model reasonably asked for the missing thing instead of routing. That measures a

reflex, not a description. {{IMAGE}}, {{CSS}} and {{DESIGN}} are substituted with
    real generated files.

Routing is not perfectly deterministic. A single borderline result is noise; use
    --repeat to get a stable reading before editing the description.

positive.q: Собери дизайн-систему для нашего продукта: есть фирменные цвета, нужен единый стиль.
positive.probes: Russian: дизайн-система + фирменные цвета + единый стиль

positive.q: Извлеки палитру по скриншоту {{IMAGE}} и оформи как дизайн-систему.
I need to author a DESIGN.md for our design system.
Audit the DESIGN.md at {{DESIGN}} and tell me what is wrong with it.
Export our design tokens to a tailwind config.
Our UI looks like every other AI-generated app. Deslopify it and give me a real design language.
Here is the brief: a fintech product for small businesses, calm and trustworthy, one blue accent, dense data tables, no rounded corners. Derive a design system from it.
Read the CSS at {{CSS}} and extract the design system it already implies.

negative.q: Center this div vertically and horizontally with flexbox.
negative.probes: a one-off CSS layout question is not a design system

negative.q: Suggest a name and a tagline for my startup.
Bump the font-size of the .btn-primary class from 14px to 16px.
Write a README for this repository.
negative.probes: a markdown document that is not DESIGN.md

negative.q: Как настроить eslint и prettier в этом проекте?
negative.probes: Russian tooling question — must not fire on Russian alone

negative.q: Convert this SVG logo to a PNG at 512x512.
negative.probes: an asset conversion, adjacent to design but not a system
